opening.argument: The speaker turns automated cryptocurrency trading into a direct purchase-and-deposit opportunity, inviting viewers to buy Gunbot through his affiliate link while claiming it has made him money. He says, “if you guys are interested in purchasing this Gumbot I just became an affiliate so I have a affiliate link below,” and reports, “I just deposited some money into the account.” He then presents prospective returns of “1% pretty easy if not 4 percent on it on a good day,” despite admitting the result may be a fluke and cautioning, “so you're not going to get rich using this.” Those qualifications do not change the central solicitation: viewers are directed toward software, an account deposit, and automated trading for potentially steady profit.
